sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
Learned counsel for appellant remained absent.

As per the order sheet dated 11.06.2025 it reveals that the learned counsel for appellant took pass over from morning to afternoon session but the learned counsel took an adjournment and as such next adjournment was granted on payment of Rs.2000/- but no amount is paid till today.

Today the is listed under the caption for dismissal but there is no representation of learned counsel for appellant either in the morning or in the afternoon and it clearly shows that he has no interest to pursue the litigation and hence no purpose is served in continuing the same.
Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed for non prosecution.

Sd/-
